figurative_meaning_en: An onomatopoeic reduplicated word denoting the sound of rain falling rapidly
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছড়ছড় করে বৃষ্টি পড়তে শুরু করল।
জানালার কাছে দাঁড়িয়ে ছড়ছড় শব্দ শুনছিলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: The rain started falling with a chhadchhad sound.
I stood by the window listening to the chhadchhad of the rain.
note: Primarily used in descriptive contexts to mimic the sound of heavy rain, common in Bengali poetry and prose depicting monsoons.
